Jordan: FYI starting 2m late so video team can finish captions sync. Agenda tweak: roadmap Q&A after demos. Please hold long questions for the doc. Recording will be on.
Mae: noted. can infra drop a single-slide latency update after PMs? 30s max.
Rory: will do the slide. also will watch for duplicate audio sources 10m pre.
Jordan: @AudioBot please run mic check with presenters in 90s.
StreamBot: Preflight OK. captions: ON. recording target s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1769065432.mp4
AudioBot: mic check in 1: Mae: "Redwood audio check"
Mae: Redwood audio check 
Rory: heard loud and clear.
Chris: preview shows a 4s caption lag in apac preview. Ops?
OpsBot: small TTL lag at apac edge ~4s, global should be ~1-2s. monitoring.
StreamBot: Recording started. viewers: 14 (pre).
Mae: OBS warned about duplicate audio in scene 'All-hands' at 10:03; disabling desktop audio now.
Jordan: if dropped frames >1% for 30s, failover to backup ingest. Ops, please arm failover.
OpsBot: failover armed. will switch after sustained threshold and page on-call.
AudioBot: placing a marker at 10:06 for a brief audio dip in prestream logs.
Rory: demo started. my screen share audio is low for remote viewers, bumping gain +3dB.
StreamBot: Recording stopped. file uploaded: s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1769065432.mp4. Transcode queued.
OpsBot: Transcode complete. 1080p mp4 and captions available at https://files.redwood/recordings/1769065432. checksums matched.
Jordan: thanks all. we'll note the caption lag and audio bump in the retro tomorrow.
